question: Who is qualified to give an explanation of a particular scripture?
premises: Teachers are distinguished by their level of scriptural knowledge.
A knower of the meaning of all scriptures is recognized as a distinct type of teacher.
Only one whose knowledge in a given scripture is well practiced by himself should explain that scripture.
inference: The right to explain a scripture belongs to the teacher who has personally mastered that scripture.
plain_english: A teacher who knows the meaning of all scriptures is taught as distinct. But in any given scripture, only the one who has thoroughly mastered it himself should give the explanation.
